cases.name: hello_request
cases.description: Handshake request written by the supervisor.

cases.name: facts_event
cases.description: Worker-initiated event; events use id zero.

cases.name: error_response
cases.description: Classified error response carrying a protocol code.

cases.name: empty_body
cases.description: Zero length prefix; the protocol forbids empty bodies.

cases.name: oversized_length
cases.description: Length prefix above the 16 MiB limit; must be rejected before allocating.

cases.name: truncated_body
cases.description: Header announces more bytes than the stream provides.

cases.name: invalid_json
cases.description: Frame boundary is correct but the body is not valid JSON; recoverable.

cases.name: foreign_version
cases.description: Envelope declares an unsupported protocol version.
